reason_unpromoted: operations/ACTIVE_QUEUE.json contains no continuity_mining-owned item; canonical queue state was not overwritten.
completed_slice: Defined an implementation-ready schema-version-2 contract for one-row-per-occurrence alias provenance with explicit lifecycle dimensions, evidence strength, uncertainty, privacy blocking, migration rules, and a falsification route.
memory_recovered: Project labels must be represented as typed, occurrence-level evidence rather than a flattened rename sequence. Every future occurrence needs minimal raw label, normalized value, structural type, lifecycle dimension and status, claim state, confidence, provenance, time uncertainty, evidence strength, and review state.

contradictions_resolved.contradiction: A shared normalized value with different statuses can appear contradictory even when one row is a canonical entity and another is a contextual alias.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Only rows sharing both normalized_value and lifecycle_dimension can form a lifecycle-status conflict.

contradictions_resolved.contradiction: Occurrence-level provenance appears to require copying private conversational context.
contradictions_resolved.resolution: Store only the minimal label token and a non-content source locator; use privacy_blocked when even minimal safe provenance is impossible.

claim_states.observed: The existing typed alias registry summarizes aliases but does not encode a complete row per source occurrence.
claim_states.inferred: Occurrence-level provenance is required to reconstruct language evolution without treating related labels as project renames.
claim_states.proposed: Future continuity occurrence artifacts should conform to the schema-version-2 contract.
claim_states.superseded: One normalized label and undifferentiated lifecycle status are sufficient for contradiction detection.
claim_states.unresolved: Historical labels lacking decision-log evidence remain unresolved rather than promoted.

verification.route: Fetched the artifact by exact commit and inspected all required fields, validation rules, migration rules, claim states, falsification route, and privacy boundary.
verification.limitation: This verifies committed source integrity, not executable validator behavior or trusted CI.

privacy_boundary: Only minimal project labels, abstract roles, statuses, source titles or paths, hashes, bounded dates, and deterministic rules were persisted. Raw private conversation and sensitive personal material were excluded.
next_action: Implement schema-version-2 fixtures and deterministic validation in the continuity scanner, then execute the committed test suite in trusted CI.
